quotations.old_english: Ne he cnihtlíce gálnysse næs begangende
quotations.english: nor was he [Guthlac] addicted to boyish levity

quotations.old_english: Swá oft swá cnihtlícu yldo begǽþ
quotations.english: as childish age is often wont

source_text: cniht-líc; adj. Boyish, childish; puerilis :-- Ne he cnihtlíce gálnysse næs begangende nor was he [Guthlac] addicted to boyish levity, Guthl. 2; Gdwin. 12, 16. Swá oft swá cnihtlícu yldo begǽþ as childish age is often wont, 2; Gdwin. 12, 19.
